## Introduction
:::

Hello! My name is Tiffany, and I'm a first-year M.S. student in Epidemiology.

I currently work as a research assistant where I analyze quantitative and qualitative data across high-stakes projects to translate complex findings into actionable recommendations for clients. Check out my [resume](resume.html).

Outside of work, I love hiking, powerlifting, and spending time with Belle.
